title:
You’ve been building, we’ve been taking notes 👀 ✏️👏

Since we rolled out Gemini 4 Argon widely two weeks ago, we’ve seen developers and creators use Argon’s deep reasoning and visual capabilities to bring ambitious projects to life.

Swipe for some of our favorite builds we’ve seen so far and learn more about how to get started creating with Argon at the 🔗 in bio.

Argon can sustain deep reasoning across large coding tasks to generate the motions of multiple elements — like realistic lighting, reflections, and water movement — simultaneously with Blender and Three.js. 🛩️

With its ability to sustain multi-step tasks, Argon was able to model individual elements in this demo before rendering them together in a 3D environment. ⚡

Instead of just seeing flat images, Argon can understand the physics behind them. That deep visual awareness is how it turned a 2D picture into a living 3D carriage, complete with working doors, reactive suspension, and flickering lights. 🛞

Argon’s strong spatial understanding and visual coding helped deliver high-precision mechanics in this capture-the-flag game. Its characters can all run, collide, whack each other, and cheer in real time. 🏁

Argon excels at turning dense, unstructured data — in this case NASA’s live wildfire data, and seismic data from the U.S. Geological Survey — into clear visuals using Google Antigravity. 🌍
